When creating a meal from these staples, you want to choose items from
at least three, if not four, of the five food groups, using carbohydrate-pro-
tein combinations with each meal. Table 4.2 shows four 650-calorie, 60
percent carbohydrate, well-balanced meals that require no cooking. The
portions are appropriate for an active woman who needs 2,000 to 2,400
calories per day; a hungry man may want more.
TABLE 4.2 650-Calorie Meals
